title: GenrePack
description: A genre pack: the minimum component set that makes a genre playable, declared as reuse of existing components plus new descriptors introduced by the pack. A pack is a planning and composition contract — it does not claim its members have runtime adapters.

loop.description: The minimum repeatable player cycle this pack must support, e.g. 'traverse → jump/avoid → collect → reach goal'.

views.description: View modes this pack defaults to. The first entry is the primary view.

memberComponents.description: Ids of existing catalog components this pack reuses. These are not owned by the pack.

newComponents.description: Ids of new component descriptors introduced by this pack. Each id must have a matching components/<category>/<Name>.component.json descriptor in the same change.

signatureCompound.description: Sketch of the one compound that proves this genre's core loop. A sketch is not a validated compound recipe; promoting it to compounds/ is a separate step.
